decisive_items: central macular thickening in fundus examination
Intraretinal cystoid changes and subfoveal ellipsoid zone disruption in the right eye
further loss of outer retinal layers in the nasal macula
response.rationale: The vignette centers on lightning-induced macular injury with OCT-documented cystoid changes, ellipsoid disruption, and outer retinal loss, all encompassed by traumatic maculopathy. R2 is a component but not the full syndrome; R4 is etiologically broad; R1 and R3 are secondary findings.

rejected.why: Electrical injury is the mechanism, not the specific macular diagnosis.
Photoreceptor damage is a subset of the macular findings, not the complete clinical entity.
Cystoid macular edema is one manifestation, not the overarching diagnosis.
Cataract is a delayed minor finding, not the primary presentation.
